cases.text: The guide must include every numbered step. Never replace the supplied visual hierarchy. Empty and failed states must show a recovery action. The artifact structure requires a title, ordered procedure, and troubleshooting section.
A reversal must be idempotent. The state moves from requested to settled only after ledger readback. Invalid currency is rejected. Never emit the external transfer twice.

The rollout shall preserve the previous image. A failed health check requires automatic rollback. The manifest file must contain model, checksum, and minimum bootloader fields. Devices in quarantined state cannot activate.
